name: Prospect to Funded Account
description: A qualified applicant receives an actionable credit decision quickly and compliantly, and can transact within days.
value_proposition: A qualified applicant receives an actionable credit decision quickly and compliantly, and can transact within days.

name: Merchant Signed to Settled
description: A merchant — usually brought by an ISO — is underwritten, boarded, and sponsored into the networks, can accept cards, and is settled daily with exposure managed.

description: A consumer buying an RV, boat, or powersports vehicle gets a financing decision at the dealer while they are standing there, and the dealer is funded within days.
value_proposition: A consumer buying an RV, boat, or powersports vehicle gets a financing decision at the dealer while they are standing there, and the dealer is funded within days.

name: Deposit Opened to Maturity
description: A saver opens a CD or savings account — directly or through a broker — funds it without friction, and is paid accurately at maturity. This stream is also how the bank funds its lending.

name: Concept to Market
description: A product change reaches market correctly disclosed, correctly priced, and correctly configured everywhere it needs to be.
value_proposition: A product change reaches market correctly disclosed, correctly priced, and correctly configured everywhere it needs to be.

name: Client Opportunity to Live Program
description: A client institution's portfolio moves onto our servicing platform with no cardholder disruption and full regulatory continuity.

name: Delinquency to Recovery
description: Accounts in difficulty are treated fairly and consistently, and the enterprise recovers what it reasonably can.
